common.rg_body: IASHARK publishes statistical football analysis. We are not a bookmaker and we do not take bets, and a probability is never a certainty. Betting involves risks (losing money, addiction). You must be 18 or over.

welcome.subject: Welcome to IASHARK: where to start
welcome.preheader: How to use the site, the free match and our methodology.
welcome.title: Welcome to IASHARK

blocks.text: Your free IASHARK account is ready. Here is how to use the site in a few minutes.

items: Every day, the full analysis of one match is free: it is highlighted on the home page.
On a match page, read the probabilities estimated by the model, the factors it takes into account and their limits.
The Methodology page explains where these figures come from and how to read them.

blocks.text: You did not ask to receive our free analyses and tips by email, so we will only send you emails about your account. You can change your mind at any time in My account, under Notifications.

blocks.text: Every day, IASHARK opens the full analysis of one match to every account, free of charge. Here is today's:
You will find the estimated probabilities, the factors used by the model and the points to watch. These are statistical estimates: the outcome of a match remains uncertain.

blocks.text: Your free account gives you the full analysis of one match a day, the blog and a preview of the tools. Here is what Pro adds:

items: The full analysis on every match
The six tools connected to the model's probabilities
Bankroll tracking linked to your account

blocks.text: Prices on the {{siteVersion}} version of the site: {{proWeekPrice}} per week, {{proPrice}} per month or {{proYearPrice}} per year. The same Pro access whichever period you choose, cancel at any time from My account.
